notes: Curved surfaces now shade smoothly, with no visible seam lines on cylinders and other round faces, and curved edges follow the real outline. The example covers on the home screen are renders of the actual models. Projects saved before this version keep their old look until the model is rebuilt.
notes_zh_tw: 曲面現在以精確的法線平滑著色，圓柱等圓形表面不再出現接縫線，曲線邊緣也貼合實際輪廓。首頁範例的封面改為模型本身的渲染圖。這版之前儲存的專案會維持舊的外觀，重新建立模型後才會更新。
